english.title: Wait / leave / park vehicle in prohibited area at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[waited in a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[left a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a part of Bristol Airport where

(D)_[waiting]_
(E)_[parking]_

was prohibited by a notice and to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.3 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
